text:
support-sarah: FYI - multiple customers reporting intermittent 502/504s and auth retries for hosted inference in eu-west2 AZ2 starting ~2026-03-17 08:03UTC. Error spike ~5-7%.
ben-support: seeing same in support queue, customers report ""request timed out"" and occasional 502 body: \"gateway timeout\".
oncall-net: alerting now, I'm looking at packet loss counters on the egress peering for AZ2.
ops-bot: [ALERT] eu-west2-az2: gateway 502 spike >5% over 10m window (hosted-api-prod).
carmen-sre: can someone paste a sample request id and timestamp to correlate logs?
ben-support: example: req=acb1f3e4 ts=2026-03-17T08:06:12Z customer=AcmeInc route=/v1/generate model=redwood-ggml-1b
alice-eng: grabbing trace for req acb1f3e4 -> backend returned 502 from gateway at 08:06:12. Backend (serving) had no OOM or CPU spike. Latency to backend nodes looked normal.
oncall-net: running quick traceroute from edge -> transit -> carrier. Getting intermittent high RTT and some packet loss between our edge (10.1.2.3) and CarrierX peer at hop 6.
ethan-ops: here's ping sample from edge host (08:05-08:10): ""ping -c 20 carrierx-peer"": 20 packets transmitted, 18 received, 10% packet loss, rtt min/avg/max = 4.2/12.8/45.6 ms.
carmen-sre: that packet loss aligns with KV cache miss latencies spiking and gateway timeouts when retries stack.
ben-support: customers also reported auth 401->502 cascades (token validation requests timing out and then gateway returning 502).
oncall-net: opening ticket with CarrierX NOC (ticket CNX-5728). Sending them pcap and mtr.
ops-bot: created carrier-ticket CNX-5728 and assigned to oncall-net.
maria-plat: can we temporarily route traffic for hosted-api eu-west2 away from the affected egress to reduce errors? We have policy to prefer eu-west1 as fallback.
oncall-net: yes, we can add a temporary egress preference at the load balancer/router; will take ~3-5m to propagate.
alice-eng: recommend enabling model-fallback and increasing client-side retry backoff for 1 minute to reduce immediate client retries and auth storms. Also set canary to route 30% traffic to eu-west1 fallback.
ben-support: notifying impacted customers with postmortem stub and repro steps so they can see mitigation.
deploy-bot: rollout started: route preference flip -> eu-west1 (30%) at 08:11:00 UTC.
oncall-net: route preference change pushed. Monitoring BGP tables and egress counters.
carmen-sre: observing error rate drop from 6.2% -> 1.0% within 2m of route change. p95 request latency improved from 920ms -> 310ms.
oncall-net: CarrierX responds: "We see microbursts/loss on our peering, investigating a hardware queue issue, will update in 15m."
ethan-ops: preserving PCAP and aggregation logs in case we need to open an escalation with global infra. Saved to /var/packet-dumps/2026-03-17-euw2-az2-carrierx.pcap.gz
alice-eng: adding a temporary rule to increase gateway proxy connection pool and extend upstream timeouts by 2s for eu-west2 to tolerate brief losses.
maria-plat: fine for 15m window; revert after carrier confirms fix.
ben-support: CS notified customers, flagged billing anomalies for requests that retried multiple times — may need to credit tokens for failed attempts.
carmen-sre: quick repro for internal debug: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
If you see 502 with upstream timeout, capture the header X-Request-Id and time.
noncall-net: follow-up from CarrierX: "We isolated a queued interface causing retransmits, applied microcode patch; loss reduced to ~0.5%."
ethan-ops: error rate holding at ~0.9% now. We'll keep canary 30% until midnight UTC then revert.
maria-plat: open action items: 1) confirm CarrierX full remediation & close CNX-5728, 2) run postmortem with timeline + customer impact, 3) review fallback routing SLA docs and remove temporary gateway timeout extension.
ben-support: filing customer credits for impacted orgs - will draft email.
alice-eng: creating a short runbook entry for egress microburst detection and recommended mitigations (route preference, extend timeouts, increase connection pool).
carmen-sre: I'll own the postmortem. tagging @oncall-net for final carrier confirmation.
oncall-net: CarrierX confirmed fixed at 08:34 UTC. Closing CNX-5728. Will follow up with traceroutes and exported metrics.
ops-bot: [RESOLVED] eu-west2-az2 gateway spike reduced below threshold. Incident state -> monitoring.
ben-support: thanks team. I'll continue customer comms until tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
